About the Maggam and Electric Machine Course

This dual-skill course combines high-demand bridal Maggam and Aari embroidery with modern electric motor sewing machine operation. Learners master intricate zardozi, stone, thread, and bead embroidery on frames, alongside high-speed industrial electric stitching machine control to increase garment production efficiency.

What You Will Learn

  • Maggam frame setup, cloth mounting and needle handling
  • Zardozi work, zari thread techniques, cut-work and bead embellishments
  • Bridal neckline motifs, border work, and tracing methods
  • Electric motor sewing machine operation and speed control
  • Safety, thread tensioning, and high-speed garment stitching

Jobs After This Course

  • Maggam and Aari embroidery artist
  • Bridal wear and boutique workshops
  • Home-based embroidery orders

Frequently Asked Questions

Who can join the Maggam and Electric Machine course?

Open to all learners interested in bridal craft and modern stitching.

How long is the Maggam and Electric Machine course?

3-4 Months. Classes are hands-on, with most of the time spent practising in the lab.

What is the fee for the Maggam and Electric Machine course?

The fee is subsidized. Asha Jyothi is a non-profit training centre, so fees are kept low for every student. Call your nearest campus for the current fee and batch timings.

What jobs can I get after the Maggam and Electric Machine course?

Maggam and Aari embroidery artist; Bridal wear and boutique workshops; Home-based embroidery orders.

Where can I join the Maggam and Electric Machine course?

Asha Jyothi runs classes at three campuses: Alwal (Secunderabad, 80196 80291), Medchal (77803 46642) and Chegunta (99498 09263). Call the campus nearest you to check when the next batch starts.
